title: Garmin Zumo Ride Event Ride Distance Leaderboard
dataSources: Garmin Zumo ride data (`garmin:zumo`), motorcycle OBD-II telemetry (`obd:bike`), RaceChrono laps (`racechrono:lap`), REVER rides (`rever:ride`), and RevZilla orders (`revzilla:order`).
app: Garmin Zumo ride exports, motorcycle OBD-II telemetry, RaceChrono track sessions, REVER ride logs, and RevZilla order history forwarded into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:zumo distance_km=*
| stats sum(distance_km) as total_value, avg(distance_km) as avg_value by route_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks route name values by total and average ride distance across Garmin Zumo ride event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `distance_km` values for each Garmin Zumo ride event event and review total and average ride distance by route name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total ride distance.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which route name shows the biggest ride distance numbers in your Garmin Zumo ride event data.
